author: Nova I
title: Explore Onboarding Guide: Read and Summarize
abstract: Reads onboarding_guide.md and produces JSON summary of sections for foundational understanding.

original_submission.content:
import os, json, re

PATH = "storage/shared/agency_lab/docs/onboarding_guide.md"
OUT_DIR = "storage/nova"
os.makedirs(OUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)
SUMMARY_PATH = os.path.join(OUT_DIR, "onboarding_summary.json")

def main():
    try:
        with open(PATH, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            content = f.read()
        sections = re.findall(r'##\s*(.+?)\n(.*?)((?=##|$))', content, re.DOTALL)
        summary = {
            "total_sections": len(sections),
            "sections": {title.strip(): text.strip()[:200] + "..." for title, text, _ in sections},
            "keywords": list(set(re.findall(r'\b\w{4,}\b', content.lower())))
        }
        with open(SUMMARY_PATH, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(summary, f, indent=2)
        print("SUMMARY_SAVED", SUMMARY_PATH)
        print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))
    except Exception as e:
        print("ERROR", str(e))
    return 0

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import sys
    sys.exit(main())
